subject: Phase 100362: Unified Read-Only clio status Health Command
verdict_justification: Phase 100362 successfully implements the core clio status health command, port scanning over 34300-34309, Compose ps integration, and ops diagnose aggregation with clean exit code semantics (0/1/2) and 100% test pass rate. However, two material issues were identified: nonexistent SQLite DB paths cause a 512KB schema bootstrap creation violating read-only non-mutation constraints, and 5 source files fail cargo fmt checking.
standard: Phase 100362 specification and Acceptance Criteria (AC-100362-01 through 05)
Non-mutation guarantee: status never writes to store or configuration under any circumstances
AGENTS.md hard constraints: file size <= 450 lines, per-file coverage >= 90% lines and functions
Code formatting and linting: make check / cargo fmt cleanliness
Sensitive data protection: credential redaction in URLs and config secret masking

requirements.requirement: AC-100362-01: One read-only command reports setup, DB, ports, Compose, diagnose
requirements.evidence: clio status command dispatches and renders setup, database, port scan, compose services, and diagnose view across both text and json output modes.
DB URL userinfo is redacted to postgres://***@host and setup secrets are masked with mask_secret (last-4 suffix); raw planted secret grep count is 0.

requirements.requirement: AC-100362-03: Exit codes 0 healthy, 1 degraded, 2 usage
requirements.evidence: Exit code 0 on healthy stack, exit code 1 on degraded backend or unreachable DB, exit code 2 on unknown --output flag or bad usage.

Config and existing stores remain untouched, and a nonexistent SQLite path is no longer created: `open_chosen` rejects a missing file before SqliteStore::open, so `clio status --backend sqlite --db /tmp/nonexistent-remed-test.db` exits 1 and leaves no file on disk (ls: No such file or directory).
clio mcp status returns unknown command exit 2; stdio framing purity is preserved.

requirements.evidence: All 9 touched Rust files are at or below 450 lines (main.rs: 322, status_cli.rs: 372, status_report.rs: 282, port_scan.rs: 64, test files: 66, 100, 235, 266, 268).

issues.title: Read-only clio status creates a 512KB database and runs schema migrations on nonexistent SQLite path
issues.why_it_matters: The command is explicitly specified as read-only with a hard guarantee that it never mutates or writes to disk (AC-100362-04). A user inspecting status with a misspelled or not-yet-created database path will find a brand new 512KB SQLite database populated on their filesystem.
issues.impact: Violates non-mutation contract (§1, §2, §7, AC-100362-04). If clio status is run by monitoring daemons before initialization, it prematurely boots schemas and creates unexpected files.
issues.evidence: Running `target/debug/clio status --backend sqlite --db /tmp/nonexistent-test-123456.db` creates `/tmp/nonexistent-test-123456.db` (512,000 bytes) on disk. In `crates/clio-lib/src/status_cli.rs:207`, `SqliteStore::open(Path::new(&resolved.url), kms)` is called without checking `Path::new(&resolved.url).exists()`.
issues.proposed_fix: In `open_chosen` (`crates/clio-lib/src/status_cli.rs:207`), check `Path::new(&resolved.url).exists()` before calling `SqliteStore::open`. If the file does not exist, return `Err(AmError::new(ErrorCode::NotFound, "database file does not exist"))`, causing status to report a degraded verdict (exit 1) without creating any files.
issues.resolution: Fixed in crates/clio-lib/src/status_cli.rs:207 (open_chosen): it now checks Path::new(&resolved.url).exists() before SqliteStore::open and returns AmError(ErrorCode::NotFound) when the file is absent. Repro after fix: `target/debug/clio status --backend sqlite --db /tmp/nonexistent-remed-test.db` -> exit 1, `diagnose: not ok ... database file does not exist: /tmp/nonexistent-remed-test.db`, and `ls /tmp/nonexistent-remed-test.db` -> No such file or directory (no file created). New test: status_probe_tests::open_chosen_missing_sqlite_file_degrades_without_creating.

issues.title: Staged files fail cargo fmt --all -- --check, causing make check to dirty working copy
issues.why_it_matters: Running `make check` executes `cargo fmt --all`, which mutates 5 source files on disk. Automated CI pipelines checking `cargo fmt --check` will fail.
issues.impact: Breaks clean checkout consistency and CI formatting verification across 5 newly introduced or modified files.
issues.evidence: `cargo fmt --all -- --check` fails with 11 diff blocks in `crates/clio-lib/src/port_scan.rs:56`, `crates/clio-lib/src/status_cli_fault_tests.rs:70`, `crates/clio-lib/src/status_cli_tests.rs:245`, `crates/clio-lib/src/status_probe_tests.rs:67`, `:105`, and `crates/clio-lib/src/status_report_tests.rs:36`, `:120`, `:151`, `:177`, `:204`, `:250`.
issues.proposed_fix: Format all files with `cargo fmt --all` and include the formatted files in the staged commit.
issues.resolution: Ran `cargo fmt --all`; `cargo fmt --all -- --check` now exits 0 (clean). Formatted: port_scan.rs:53, status_cli_fault_tests.rs:70, status_cli_tests.rs:245, status_probe_tests.rs:67/105, status_report_tests.rs (all 11 diff blocks). Verified by make check (exit 0).

issues.title: SetupView secret masking only scans setup_config::WATCHED_FIELDS rather than all deployment overlay keys
issues.why_it_matters: If deployment.json contains other sensitive credentials (such as custom extract or API keys), they are not detected or masked under SetupView.secrets.
issues.impact: Uncommon custom deployment secrets may not appear in the masked secrets list in status output.
issues.evidence: `crates/clio-lib/src/status_cli.rs:309-319` loops over `crate::setup_config::WATCHED_FIELDS` which only contains embed and rerank credentials.
issues.proposed_fix: Either expose an iterator/accessor for all overlay keys on `clio_config::Runtime` or document the limitation in Phase 100362 Known Limitations.
issues.resolution: Fixed more strongly than 'document': added clio_config::Runtime::deployment_keys() (crates/clio-config/src/config/mod.rs:221) and build_setup now masks every secret-bearing overlay key discovered from the overlay itself instead of the fixed setup_config::WATCHED_FIELDS allowlist. Evidence: a deployment.json with `extract.token` and `custom.secret` renders `"secrets":{"custom.secret":"****7890","extract.token":"****mnop"}` and grep for the raw values returns 0. New test: status_probe_tests::build_setup_masks_secret_keys_outside_the_watched_allowlist.

issues.title: Unit test occupied_port_is_reported does not test port within 34300-34309 range
issues.why_it_matters: Scenario T100362-03 specifies verifying 'A listener bound on 34300'. The test binds port 0 to avoid host port collisions, leaving the actual boundary port 34300 covered only by range bounds checks.
issues.impact: Slight test contract gap between scenario specification and test fixture.
issues.proposed_fix: Add an integration test that attempts binding to 34300 and scans `listening_ports()` if the port is free.
issues.resolution: Added crates/clio-lib/src/port_scan_tests.rs::listener_on_contract_port_is_reported, which binds 127.0.0.1:34300 (FIRST_PORT, the range's first port) and asserts listening_ports() reports it; when the host already occupies 34300 the test asserts the occupied port is still reported. The existing ephemeral-port test is retained.
